text: Regulatory Compliance Adaptation Model for Cross-Border Payment Product Redesign presents the following source proposition: Cross-border payment systems face increasing scrutiny from regulators due to heightened concerns around anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorism financing (CTF), and financial transparency. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Firms that outsource the chief compliance officer role to third parties face heightened SEC scrutiny and examination risk, and the SEC has signaled that CCO liability arises where CCOs mislead regulators, engage in affirmative misconduct, or fail to carry out assigned compliance responsibilities.
